description: Most UCR chronology public gatherings lack any headcount. The opened Feb18 TEC report says more than 80 TEC representatives in its caption and around 80 TEC people in its narrative, enough to support the threshold for that event while leaving an internal count-wording discrepancy. The opened Feb16 Liverpool blockade article reports about 20 demonstrators, below the threshold as reported. The Feb22 municipal report says close to 50 labor representations, not a headcount. Other gatherings remain uncounted.
